long_biography.plain_text:
Al Rabil helped create The Headstrong Project after Marine veteran Zach Iscol described the difficulty his fellow veterans faced in obtaining mental healthcare. Rabil joined Iscol and financier Dave Petrucco in founding the organisation in 2012, working with Weill Cornell Medicine to provide treatment.

Headstrong built a network of clinicians offering confidential outpatient care to veterans, service members and their families. It brought mental health services in-house in 2021 to oversee clinical work alongside its business and fundraising operations. Rabil has continued as a board member, while the organisation uses telehealth to maintain treatment when clients move between states.
